newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch welcome new Samsung, Fokker talks.
newsitem.headline: Dutch welcome new Samsung, Fokker talks.

text.p: The Dutch government on Friday welcomed a latest "serious" approach for bankrupt planemaker Fokker NV by South Korea's Samsung Aerospace Industries.

Confirming an earlier Fokker statement that Samsung was holding fresh talks with both the planemaker and the government, Economic Affairs Minister Hans Wijers said the discussions were "very serious" and would hopefully lead to a full business plan from the Koreans.

"What happens next is a little unclear, but we (the state) are waiting for a business plan which could form the basis for further discussions," he told reporters at an unrelated news conference in The Hague.
"It is very clear that Samsung is interested in Fokker and we are interested in Samsung -- it's the type of company that would fit very well," Wijers added, declining to elaborate or take questions.
